dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Well, I'm currently considering how to arrange the various utensils we use here at the hotel.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: I used to place them in a rack close to the outside, which would make them easy to take and use.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: But Lynette once knocked them over when she was invited to perform here, causing them to clatter to the ground, shattering on impact.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Fortunately, Lynette wasn't hurt — everyone would surely have been grieved if her beautiful face was injured by mistake...
